headline: Microsoft agent-framework PyPI compromise
label: CONFIRMED
latest: Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 quarantined; root cause not confirmed.

log.text: Microsoft confirms removal and investigation; how the upload occurred is disputed.

headline: NVIDIA leak-site listing by Gentlemen ransomware
label: UNCONFIRMED CLAIM

headline: Java4Shell OpenJDK flaw exploitation attempts

headline: Optimizely script injection on 178+ websites

headline: Crimean Bridge strikes and Russian retaliation vow

headline: European Commission cyberattack
